results.title: Marinella
results.overview: In the Milan of the economic boom, Maria Boccuzzi –aka Marinella –is a young Calabrian in search of redemption. At just 16 years old, she runs away from home for love, but that choice leads her down a path of solitude, marginalization and broken dreams. Abandoned and without ties, she ends up in prostitution, continuing to pursue her desire to become a dancer. It is precisely that hope, never extinguished, that leads her to death at the hands of a mysterious man. Marinella will not have justice, but telling her story is an act of rebellion: a way to give her the dignity that life has denied her.

results.title: Notte prima degli esami 3.0
results.overview: On the eve of their final exams, a group of Roman high school students find themselves experiencing their last great adventure together: secret loves, betrayals, tested friendships, and desperate plans to deceive the school's most feared teacher.

results.title: Hold to Death: Hand in Hand
results.overview: The teacher is invited by someone she likes to join a class reunion. They play a game to invite ghosts to make friends, unaware that curses are placed upon them. There is a reason for the malevolence.

results.title: We've Lost Dale Earnhardt: 25 Years Later
results.original_title: We've Lost Dale Earnhardt: 25 Years Later
results.overview: Told through exclusive first-person accounts, rare home video, archival broadcast footage and cinematic storytelling, this documentary revisits the death of seven-time NASCAR champion Dale Earnhardt and examins the profound ripple effects that continue to shape the sport and its culture 25 years later.

results.title: Maws
results.overview: A group of criminals known as The Hanover Gang rob and murder a rival gang. They hit the road and end up in a small seaside town called Luna Pier where they fall prey to a horrifying half-man, half-shark Nazi experiment.

The events depicted in the film embody the spirit, determination, and self-sacrifice of a generation that stood up to defend the Homeland, as exemplified by the special forces. At the center of the plot stand Special Forces officer Rashad Khalilov, Zeynep Ozdemir—a Turkish orthopedic surgeon working in Azerbaijan—and Colonel Ramazan Karimov, commander of the special operations group.

results.title: It Was All Her!
results.overview: Talented as a child but completely lost in her thirties, Vasya suddenly realizes she's heading for rock bottom and has no strength to escape. Malvina, an imaginary friend from childhood, comes to his aid, a freakish woman with purple hair and a quirky sense of humor. Malvina pushes Vasya to find her childhood love, Stasik. Vasya will go through a long journey and understand what went wrong in her life, but most importantly, she will learn why Malvina appeared.

results.title: Bail
results.overview: After a long wait for justice in a case that affected him personally, retired commissioner Vijay Kumar becomes an outlaw who serves justice.

results.title: NJPW Road to Destruction 2026 - Day 5
results.overview: The fifth night of Road to Destruction 2026 took place on September 15, 2026, at Hokuto City General Gymnasium in Hokuto City, Hokkaido, Japan.

results.title: The Poet and the Spy
results.overview: In 1919 Fiume, Russian spy Beatrice navigates political turmoil while protecting poet Gabriele D’Annunzio, entangling with an intelligence chief and a WWI deserter amid Italy’s revolutionary unrest.

results.title: A Wicked Muse
results.overview: A struggling novelist makes a deal with a demonic spirit promising to catapult his writing career to stardom.

results.title: Influenced
results.overview: Renowned influencer Dzanielle navigates fake friends among the elite, Ozempic-sharting Upper East Siders, only to discover her true self and her first genuine friendship amidst her comedic quest for a million followers.

results.title: Eclipse
results.overview: 1960. There's an outbreak of smallpox in Moscow. This incurable deadly disease was considered conquered in the USSR. To fight the possible epidemic the KGB assigns colonel Shilov. He dives into the struggle at once because he has an old account to settle with smallpox. The task is to locate all those infected and stop the spread of the virus. But it is not an easy mission. The infection has spread to the underworld of the capital. Shilov must look for answers in the depths of the criminal world, unearthing its inhabitants and secrets.

results.title: Suri Anna
results.overview: A gripping story of a man torn between circumstances and conscience, who is drawn into the dark world of crime. As his choices spiral out of control, only the unconditional love of his parents keeps him grounded.

results.title: She's the He!
results.overview: To protect their reputations before graduation, two friends pretend to be trans women—only for a comedic stunt to turn into a profound journey of self-discovery when one of them realizes her truth.

results.title: Downtown
results.overview: In 1988, three young gay men, Ronnie, Lennart and Bas, throw themselves into Amsterdam's nightlife  scene. It’s a life full of friendship, sex and drugs. Until the mysterious AIDS virus casts a shadow over their  lives and one of them disappears after becoming infected. Thirty-two years later, in the middle of the 2021  lockdown, Ronnie recognises the missing Bas in the subway. An evening unfolds that none of them had  expected to see, but which had been in the air for years. The AIDS epidemic has had a major impact on all  three of their lives. Where they lost each other 32 years ago, they hope to find each other again.

results.title: The Butcher's Blade
results.overview: Local constable Xue Buyi keeps his distance from corrupt colleagues until he is framed for the theft of thousands of dollars in relief funds. Now he must choose: fight to clear his name or uphold the law he's sworn to obey.
